title: Local and Global Recursive Ridge Regression for Online Residual Correction of Frozen Multivariate Forecasters under Label Delay
abstract: arXiv:2610.29604v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A frozen multi-horizon forecaster can be corrected online from its own residuals. However, under label delay the target of a block arrives only after the whole horizon has passed, and the corrector's retained state grows with the number of channels. Aiming to combine a small retained state with a large error reduction, we propose DRiC (DCT Ridge Corrector), which fits a ridge regression of the leading discrete cosine transform (DCT) coefficients of the next residual block on those of the frozen forecast and of the latest input block, with sufficient statistics updated recursively. Its local variant, DRiC-L, keeps one such regression per channel; its global variant, DRiC-G, pools all channels into one regression, whose statistics do not depend on the channel count. translated_title: 面向标签延迟下冻结多元预测器在线残差校正的局部与全局递归岭回归方法
translated_abstract: 冻结的多步预测器可以基于其自身的残差进行在线校正。然而，在标签延迟的情况下，一个数据块的目标值只有在整个预测时域结束之后才会到达，并且校正器保留的状态会随着通道数量的增加而增长。为了在保留较小状态的同时实现较大的误差降低，我们提出了 DRiC（DCT 岭回归校正器），它以递归更新的充分统计量，将下一个残差块的主离散余弦变换（DCT）系数对冻结预测和最新输入块的相应系数进行岭回归拟合。其局部变体 DRiC-L 为每个通道保留一个这样的回归；其全局变体 DRiC-G 将所有通道汇集到一个回归中，其统计量不依赖于通道数量。系统还设置了一个保护机制，跟踪冻结预测残差在每个通道上的运行尺度；对于远超该尺度的数据块，它会跳过更新，并对发出的校正进行裁剪。我们评估了……
tldr: 提出DRiC方法，利用基于主DCT系数的递归岭回归和固定规模充分统计量，在标签延迟与小状态约束下对冻结多元预测器进行在线残差校正，提供按通道建模的局部变体和跨通道池化的全局变体，并通过残差尺度保护机制抵御异常数据块。
en_tdlr: Proposes DRiC, which performs online residual correction of frozen multivariate forecasters under label delay using recursive ridge regression on leading DCT coefficients with fixed-size sufficient statistics, offering per-channel (DRiC-L) and channel-pooled (DRiC-G) variants with an outlier-guard mechanism.
